description:
Archive a store (use instead of delete for stores with order history — order records are kept for accounting, but the store is hidden from the default listing and stops ingesting new orders). Restore it later with unarchive_store. Set disconnect_provider=true to also disconnect every connected fulfillment provider and remove its stored credentials.

[#b85c96]

disconnect_provider.description: Also disconnect connected fulfillment providers and remove their credentials (default false).

workspace.description: Workspace uuid to scope to (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: archive_store
